changelog: **Interview requests become real meetings (#1844):** the two declared-but-dead statuses are finally written. `POST /api/interview-requests/[id]/schedule` (ADMIN or the mentee's active MENTOR — the actor rule now lives in `interviewRequestActorWhere()` and is shared with the decision route) turns an APPROVED request into a `Meeting` linked in both directions (`InterviewRequest.meetingId`, `scheduledAt`), on the IANA zone the approver picked, with the company's interviewers invited as `MeetingGuest`s (addresses, never accounts); the status flip is a guarded `updateMany` in the same transaction as the meeting, so two concurrent calls produce one meeting and one `409 not_approved`, and a slot the company did not propose needs `override: true`. `POST /api/interview-requests/[id]/cancel` (the programme, or the company for its own request) writes `CANCELLED` with the reason and takes the meeting off every calendar through the new shared `cancelMeetingRows()` (`src/lib/meetingCancel.ts`, also used by `PATCH /api/meetings/[id]`) — never by deleting the row. The mentee, the mentor and the company are told the confirmed time in their own zone and language (`interview_request.scheduled` / `.cancelled`, registered in the notification catalogue and in `WEBHOOK_EVENTS`). The queue replaces its deep link with an inline slot picker, time-zone select, interviewer e-mails and a cancel control; the company's requisition page shows the confirmed time or the cancellation instead of an instruction.

en: Interview requests can now be scheduled in the app: pick one of the company's proposed times (or another one), name the time zone, invite the company's interviewers by e-mail, and everyone sees the confirmed time on their own clock. A scheduled interview can be cancelled with a reason, which also removes it from the calendars.
tr: Mülakat talepleri artık uygulamada planlanıyor: şirketin önerdiği saatlerden birini (ya da başka bir saati) seç, saat dilimini belirt, şirketin mülakatçılarını e-postayla davet et; herkes kesinleşen saati kendi saatine göre görür. Planlanan bir mülakat gerekçeyle iptal edilebilir, iptal takvimlerden de düşer.
de: Interviewanfragen lassen sich jetzt in der App terminieren: einen der vom Unternehmen vorgeschlagenen Termine (oder einen anderen) wählen, die Zeitzone angeben, die Interviewer des Unternehmens per E-Mail einladen – alle sehen die bestätigte Zeit auf ihrer eigenen Uhr. Ein geplantes Interview kann mit Begründung abgesagt werden, was es auch aus den Kalendern entfernt.
